data.name: Cave Crave: Real Spelunking
data.detailed_description:
Whether you're charting new territory or racing against time to save lives, Cave Crave: Real Spelunking delivers a deeply atmospheric journey through the most dangerous terrain known to humankind—Earth's own underworld.

Claustrophobic Exploration
Feel the pressure of every crawlspace and the silence of the deep underground. Designed to evoke the real terror of tight spaces, this game is not for the faint of heart.

Discover Lost Worlds
Uncover ancient artifacts, forgotten cave systems, and evidence of civilizations long buried beneath the surface.

Dynamic Rescue Missions
Respond to distress calls from missing explorers, delve into unstable tunnels, and make impossible choices to bring people back—or leave them behind.

Realistic Gear & Progression
Customize your loadout with rope, harnesses, oxygen tanks, sonar, and more. The deeper you go, the more critical your preparation becomes.

Underwater Cave Diving
Venture into submerged labyrinths with limited oxygen and fading visibility. One wrong turn could be your last.

Unfold a Mystery
Piece together journal entries, cave markings, and clues left behind by explorers who came before you. What lies beneath may not be entirely natural...

data.short_description: Step into the abyss in "Cave Crave" - a first-person spelunking and cave-diving experience that will push your nerves and survival instincts to their limits. Navigate through uncharted cave systems, squeeze through narrow crevices, and plunge into underwater tunnels in a hauntingly immersive world.
data.supported_languages:
English*, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Japanese, Korean, Polish, Russian, Simplified Chinese, Turkish, Portuguese - Brazil, Ukrainian
*languages with full audio support

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 / AMD Ryzen 5 1600
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce GTX1060 / AMD Radeon RX580
  • Storage: 40 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-11400 / AMD Ryzen 5 3600
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce RTX3060 / AMD RX 6600 XT
  • Storage: 40 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible
